title: 2026-11-28 — A whitespace-free comparison of moved Rust still differs by the commas rustfmt drops

data.head: ## 2026-11-28 — A whitespace-free comparison of moved Rust still differs by the commas rustfmt drops

body:
A pure-move check that compares a moved body with its old text after removing all whitespace still reads a
difference when the move dedented the code: `cargo fmt` lets a wrapped list fit one line and drops its trailing
comma. Name a second rule beside the measure — also drop a comma before `)`, `]` or `}` — apply it only where the
first rule reads a difference, and mark each item it settles, so the record's count states which rule each match
stands on (chunk 2026-11-27-epoch-5-cleanup-2, 3 of 159 items).

title: 2026-11-28 — A move into a sibling module tree needs every module on the path opened

data.head: ## 2026-11-28 — A move into a sibling module tree needs every module on the path opened

body:
Widening a moved item's type to `pub(crate)` does not let a sibling module tree name it while a parent module on the
path stays private: `crate::cmd::run::WindowAsk` stayed unnameable from `crate::run::window` until `cmd`'s own
`mod run;` became `pub(crate) mod run;`. Before planning a cross-tree move, read the visibility of each module on the
path, not the item alone (chunk 2026-11-27-epoch-5-cleanup-2, plan step 7).

The session split three oversized pieces of code as pure moves with no behaviour change: the up command's planner, the PTY pump's respawn, and the run start's window and trust steps.
The up command's top function now hands off to three private helpers (select, plan, act) and still opens the cli.up span; the pump loop takes one helper that reads the next respawn request.
The pump's respawn, its reap wait and its output drain moved into a private restart module of the pump crate, which still exports the reap bound, the Respawn outcome and the respawn handle under the same names.
The start's window step moved beside the window-step code, and the folder-trust step moved into the trust record module; the trust-record INFO log line keeps its event and detail word, but its tracing target now reads viola::trust_record (was viola::cmd::run).
The pump's and the run command's unit tests moved into separate files and new submodules (pump::tests::paste, pump::tests::respawn, cmd::run::tests::start; one case went to trust_record::tests), so those cases' test paths changed. Case counts did not change and no public API, IPC method, CLI output, exit code or config changed.
Measured: every file it touched is at or under 800 code lines, and every function it touched is at or under cognitive complexity 15.

body:
The session split three oversized parts as pure moves under the Epoch 5 audit's size and complexity ceilings: viola up's planner, the pty pump's respawn, and viola run's window and trust steps.
viola up's single body was split into three private steps (select, plan, act) under the same cli.up span; up still calls it alone.
The pump's respawn (the child swap, the reap within its bound, the drain) moved into its own private module of the pty crate, and the pump loop took one helper; the crate's exported names are unchanged.
viola run's window step moved beside the window module and its trust-folder step moved into the trust record component; the trust-record INFO line keeps its event and detail word but its log target now reads viola::trust_record (was viola::cmd::run).
No public API, IPC method, endpoint, env var, socket, port, dependency, config or schema changed; nothing was retired; case counts are unchanged and 159 moved bodies were measured equal.

body_fields.what: viola up, the command that starts a set of instances; its checks before its log and before any spawn, now split into select, plan and act steps (edited)
the PTY pump, the passthrough loop that copies child output, forwards resizes, writes bracketed pastes and keeps the wheel between human typing and the driver (edited)
the pump's respawn: swapping the wrapper's own child for a new one, reaping the old child within its bound and draining its output (new, moved from the pump)
the pump's unit tests: output drain, resize forwarding, worker panic kill, writer end (new, moved from the pump)
the pump's paste tests: one bracketed paste written whole, a cut paste, human keys waiting behind a paste, refused pastes (new, moved from the pump)
the pump's respawn tests: the child swap, a child ignoring the signal, a failed spawn, the reap bound, the exit drain (new, moved from the pump)
viola run, the wrapper's start shared by run, revive and adopt; its version gate, collision check, window step and trust step call sites (edited)
viola run's unit tests: the channel methods' routing, the release-from-driver refusal, hook event re-validation, the collision check over a replayed snapshot (new, moved from run)
viola run's start tests: the first snapshot's links, cwd, lineage, launch pair and window lines, and the hidden window, lineage and launch flags' parsing (new, moved from run)
the wrapper's window step, which moves only its own terminal's window by the recorded origin and place; now holds open_window (edited)
the trust record writer, which writes the folder-trust flag at a verified start and skips the home and already trusted folders; now holds the trust-folder step and its closed outcome word (edited)
the CLI command module tree; viola run's module widened to crate visibility (edited)

decision/switch-ends-only-its-own-child: the respawn that switch drives moved whole into the pump's own restart module; it still ends only the wrapper's own child.

decision/human-typing-takes-wheel and decision/bridge-send-one-bracketed-paste and decision/send-text-is-one-bracketed-paste: the pump loop took a helper and its paste tests moved to their own file; the behaviour and the cases are unchanged.
decision/window-step-moves-own-terminal-window and decision/hyprland-recorder-moves-own-window: the window step moved from viola run into the window module unchanged.

decision/run-window-flags-checked and decision/window-origin-authenticates-nothing: the window ask with its origin and place fields widened to crate visibility so the window module can name it; the checks did not change.

The trust-record INFO log line's target moved to viola::trust_record from viola::cmd::run; any row naming the log line's target or its module path is touched, and the log filter lists the crate prefix viola so the line is still written.

decision/verify-never-answers-import-dialog and contract/verify-refusal-codes/untrusted-folder: indirectly, through the trust step a verified start runs, which moved; verify's own callers did not change.

decision/collision-check-needs-no-server-verify and decision/driver-release-refused and decision/release-from-driver-guard: their unit tests moved into viola run's test files; the checks and the cases are unchanged.

Mutants tested by their own package and mutation base is the whole chunk: every moved function keeps its tests in its own package (viola-pty or the root crate).

Real window placement proven only live and the window step keeping the view: the window step moved modules; its unit cases still run.

viola up's planning: upped split into select, plan and act, still the verb's sole callee and still under the cli.up span.
